items.html: That place of the fourteen Sefirot was then the zone of the Olamot, such as we place in every town a Shabbat Zone around it. This is the meaning of the words of our sages why He is called El Shadai, since He said to His world Dai (Heb: enough). Interpretation: As these four Olamot ABYA expanded when they reached the place of Sium of the sixth Sefira of the current Yetzira, He said to them “Dai, do not expand and do not enter the zone of the above-mentioned fourteen.” Instead, they would remain a Halal for the Klipot as was mentioned.
